1. Heard Mr.Subramaniam Iyer, the learned advocate for the petitioner and Mr.Sanjay Udhwani, the Vinod Pandya vs State Of Gujarat - Thro Secretary Food ...

learned Assistant Government Pleader appearing for the State Respondent.
The written instructions supplied in the Court by Mr.Sanjay Udhwani, the learned Assistant Government Pleader are taken on record.

2. The present petition, in the nature of Public Interest Litigation, has been filed in the year 2013 to raise issues about the large scale irregularities in the public distribution system all over the State.
C/WPPIL/27/2013 O

3. The affidavit of Under Secretary, Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs Department, State of Gujarat dated 20.09.2021 filed on behalf of the respondent No.1 indicates the rectification measures to strengthen the public distribution system in the following manner:-
"6. That, as already submitted in report dated 08/01/2016, the particular district i.e.
the Panchmahal district was having hundred percent barcoded ration cards and the process of biometric identification was also completed at the relevant point of time.

It is respectfully submitted that from 2016 till date, there are many such upgradation in the system in form of digitalization and the steps taken are as under;
6.1 Steps taken to strengthen to check the Irregularities for fair price shop:
A. That, Intensive inspections and raids are carried out by the state and District level to ensure that the beneficiaries get the quantity of goods available to them in a timely,
fast and fixed quantity/price and to stop the black market.

The details of the inspection are attached here with as a Annexure-RR-1 (Panchmahal Dist.) and Annexure-RR-2 (All District).
B.

All the PDS (public distribution system) transactions are now being done by Aadhaar based Authentication and it would automatically strengthen the security and safety and only rightful person would be benefited.

Vinod Pandya vs State Of Gujarat - Thro Secretary Food ... on 30 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/108950184/
2 C. Authorization at various stages of various applications or software Related to public distribution system for critical stages such as generating ration cards, splitting,
issuing permits, withdrawing quantities, etc., and it be granted access Only after being authorized by Aadhaar based fingerprint is completed.
D.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In case of any Complaint or Grievance received in PDS, District and Taluka authorities are instructed to verify all the transactions done by particular FPS since last 2 years.
Along with the transactions, the district and taluka authorities are also instructed to take survey of all the beneficiaries for their eligibility and existence of the beneficiaries.
C/WPPIL/27/2013 ORDER
It is respectfully submitted that by way of the steps, the state government is keen to see that the irregularities are oust.
7. That, following Steps are taken to strengthen Ration card Management system (RCMS):
A. That, the state government has initiated this mission mode project with the help of state NIC in 2010.
The Barcoded Ration Card for beneficiaries implemented in 2010.

It is submitted that In March 2018 Gujarat government has implemented "Aadhaar based" Authentication of ration card holders for getting their entitlement through FPS.
B.
That, Ration Card related applications are accepted at ATVT center or on Digital Gujarat portal (Digital Seva Setu) through VCE and processed by RCMS.
To achieve the accountability, up to Bottom level Aadhaar Based authentication at various key decision stages.

Ration Card related all Services (New cards, Division of cards,
Vinod Pandya vs State Of Gujarat - Thro Secretary Food ... on 30 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/108950184/
3 addition/deletion of members, amendments in cards, cancellation of cards etc.) are fully Aadhaar Based Authentication.

entities.text: Vinod Pandya vs State Of Gujarat - Thro Secretary Food
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 8. That, the Steps are also taken to strengthen public distribution system (end to end Computerization) by the state government.

It is further submitted that in the entire state, the beneficiaries covered under "National Food Security Act-2013" are availed essential commodities, including wheat, rice, sugar, edible oil, pulses, salt etc. at concessional rates under public distribution system through fair price shops.

It is further submitted that following steps have been taken to strengthen the distribution system and to oust and minimize the irregularities in the state;
A. Under "National Food Security Act-2013" in order to provide benefits to the eligible beneficiaries State Government has been doing Aadhaar seeding of Ration Cards and beneficiaries.
As on 18- 09-2021, Aadhaar seeding of 99.7% ration cards and 96.0% beneficiaries has been completed.
Necessary instruction for completion of 100% Aadhaar seeding has been given to all District level officers and review of the same is taken regularly.

B. From March-2018 state government has implemented the Aadhaar based Public Distribution System, in which beneficiaries can avail their benefits by establishing the Identity through their biometric, registered at "Aadhaar.
To avoid any irregularity, no biometrics are stored on local servers.

As per the NFSA Act-2013, no beneficiary can be denied the essential commodity, thus if any NEUTRAL CITATION C/WPPIL/27/2013 ORDER DATED: 30/07/2025 undefined beneficiary doesn't have Aadhaar or Aadhaar number for any reason they can avail their benefit by giving any of the prof from 13 different types of identity proofs which are fixed by State government by Government Resolution.
It is submitted that by the steps, there are absolutely minimum chances of any irregularity.

Copies of government resolutions are attached here with as ANNEXURE-RR-3.
C.

In order to avoid diversion of quantity to be given to reasonable price Shops from godown operated by Gujarat State Civil Supplies Corporation Ltd. the State Government delivers the quantity of essential items to their shops through centralized system which is known as doorstep delivery (DSD).
D.

entities.text: Gujarat State Civil Supplies Corporation Ltd.
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: An SMS is also sent to the mobile number of the beneficiary when the ration card holder generates a food receipt by giving a fingerprint under the Aadhaar based distribution system.
In which various details including available quantity, quantity received and its price are available.

E. From all the applications of public distribution system, various types of reports have been made available for monitoring/controlling the distribution system at state, district, taluka and village level.

F. To avoid further irregularities, Ration Card holders, who are not availing their benefits from 6 to 12 months, these Ration card is Identified in Online PDS System and card holders Card are temporarily Disabled/Blocked form PDS System through NIC.

4 G.

entities.text: Vinod Pandya vs State Of Gujarat - Thro Secretary Food
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Disabled/Blocked Ration Card holders will be required to apply for UIDAI-eKYC process of Aadhaar Seeding for all members by contacting the concerned Mamlatdar Office / Zonal Office to reactive the Card.
This is verified by Concern DSO to reactivate the ration card.
This will mostly oust and minimize chance of any irregularity."

4. Today, when the matter was taken up, Mr.Sanjay Udhwani, the learned Assistant Government Pleader appearing for the State respondent provided written instructions in compliance of the order dated 23.07.2025, to place before us that the Public Distribution System NEUTRAL CITATION C/WPPIL/27/2013 ORDER DATED: 30/07/2025 undefined Mechanism now set in place Aadhar based e-KYC based implementation, which is nationwide, village level and the Public Grievance Redressal System is set to address the issues relating to commodity, quantity, malpractices by Fair Price Shops operators and other concerns.
Fair Price Shops E- Profiling is being done through biometric system, Geo- Fencing, E-FPS Web Application and GPS tracking etc.
Even the mechanism of Route Optimization has been developed with software analysis and recommendations from IIT Delhi.

5. The written instructions supplied by the Joint Director, Food and Civil Supplies, Gandhinagar,
states that these initiatives have shown effective implementation of Public Distribution System Mechanism in a transparent manner and malpractices are minimized with the current system.
6. In view of the above, we dispose of the present petition with the observation that all efforts shall be made for effective implementation of the current system.

(SUNITA AGARWAL, CJ ) (D.N.RAY,J) SAHIL S. RANGER Vinod Pandya vs State Of Gujarat - Thro Secretary Food ... on 30 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/108950184/
